name: fleet-week
title: Fleet checks and holds
subtitle: Recorded evidence for an operator review, not permission to drive.

sections.title: Daily checks
sections.sql: select * from prestart_queue order by asset

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by asset,rule

sections.title: Open defects
sections.sql: select asset,defect,severity,owner,age_days,due_date from defect_queue where status='open' order by age_days desc

sections.title: Services
sections.sql: select * from service_queue order by due_date nulls first

sections.title: By asset and currency
sections.note: Entered repair costs only. No fuel, lost revenue or unentered labour.
sections.sql: select a.name asset,r.currency,sum(r.cost_cents) cost_cents from repairs r join defects d on d.id=r.defect_id join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id group by a.name,r.currency order by a.name,r.currency
